title: Zesty Middle Eastern Tuna Tagine
description: A light and flavorful Middle Eastern dish featuring tuna, flambe, and a blend of aromatic spices, cooked to perfection in a traditional clay tajine vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the clay tajine vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the flaked tuna and cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and lemon juice.
Flambe the mixture by adding a small amount of oil to the hot vessel and igniting it, then quickly covering the vessel with a lid.
Remove the lid and stir the mixture, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve the tuna tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
